content.text: The full log shows EPEL repository metadata failures: a mirror certificate error and checksum mismatches. This happened before compilation; both macOS builds and the source distribution passed. I’ll disable EPEL for this install step, since `git` and `mesa-libGL` come from AlmaLinux’s standard repositories.

content.text:
The [Linux job failed](https://github.com/gkeyllorg/postgkyl/actions/runs/39620296223/job/119291670266) before compilation because EPEL mirrors returned certificate and checksum errors. Both macOS builds and the source distribution passed.

Updated [pyproject.toml](/home/maxwell-rosen/postgkyl/pyproject.toml:162) to disable EPEL for this dependency install; the required packages use AlmaLinux repositories.

Configuration checks passed. Container verification was blocked by Docker socket permissions, so CI still needs to validate the fix. Changes are local.
